open.gap: No sandwich-sphere test series at Vc > 2 was read. Unity rests on the handbook's imperfection claim plus axial cylinder tests, one of which reached 0.86 of the prediction.
Sim 2024 does not state Gc. Vc uses G = E/2 from the stated foam modulus and Poisson 0. Their 0.20 and 0.22 are imperfect-over-perfect finite-element ratios, not tests against CR-1457.
The optimistic line is a projection. The handbook declined to publish a transitional knockdown.
P3 lattice buckling and member bending remain unscored.
